open_issues.impact: The GUI form (P2.3) can only remove empty projects; for a project with plans it must offer detach or show the PROJECT_NOT_EMPTY message. If the owner wants a destructive removal with plans (--force, or archiving via status=archived), it is a separate decision.

open_issues.text: The goal says 'project remove CODE' without defining it. I implemented it as removal of an empty project from the workspace plus its binding, and refuse any project that holds plans, legacy plans, migrations or a local-only index (PROJECT_NOT_EMPTY). There is no force option. It is not a rename of detach: detach still only drops the binding.

open_issues.text: Nothing is emitted for project remove. I added no new event type, to avoid new event-data schemas and a unit.json change. project add emits workspace.project.attached like attach, on every call including repeats with created=false (existing attach behaviour).

open_issues.impact: Not fully atomic across a network failure after the creation step.
open_issues.text: init --remote on a new workspace has a small window: the remote is read first, then the workspace is created, then origin is added. If the final connect fails (for example the remote changed or went away in between), the new workspace stays without a remote and the error is shown. Re-running init --remote or connect fixes it.

summary: init --code CODE --remote URL now creates the workspace and binds it to the remote as origin in one step (remote.create). The remote is read first and must be empty, otherwise REMOTE_NOT_EMPTY or REMOTE_UNREACHABLE and nothing is created. On an existing workspace it only connects (REMOTE_ALREADY_SET if origin exists). Nothing is pushed. project add --path DIR [--name] [--code] [--yes] does the work of attach with a required path and the same output and event. project remove CODE deletes projects/CODE/ and its binding on this machine, but only when the project holds nothing but project.json and an empty plans store; otherwise PROJECT_NOT_EMPTY and nothing changes. Markers in checkouts are left alone and listed in `markers`. project list --all lists the projects of every workspace without choosing one (rows carry `workspace`, unreadable workspaces go to `skipped`). Contracts: new project-add and project-remove; init gained optional `remote` and `next`; project-list gained optional row field `workspace` and `skipped`. Tests (CreateBindAddTests plus broken-document cases) are in tests/test_command_contracts.py. README and CHANGELOG are updated. Test commands run: unittest discover of packages/workspace/tests (311 tests, OK), the touched test files again (113 tests, OK), scripts/ecosystem-units.py check (exit 0).
